title: Claude scores full marks, GPT scores 99 points, He Kaiming's team has completely aced the AGI exam.
key_facts: A paper called VISTA from He Kaiming's team, uploaded to arXiv during China's National Day holiday, reports near-perfect ARC-AGI-3 results
With Claude Opus 5, the system cleared all 183 levels across the 25 public games and scored 100, per 36Kr
The same model scored about 40 in the official standard test
VISTA replaces the 64x64 grid of numbers with game images and adds a frame 'album' the model can review without spending game steps
Switching to images alone lifted GPT-5.6 Sol from 13.33 to 47.32
The prompt is four sentences and no new model was trained
Claude's 7302 total steps were about 0.43 times those of first-time human players
quote_evidence: Claude directly cleared all 25 public games of ARC-AGI-3 and got a perfect score of 100!
According to the paper, VISTA is the first system that achieves full score or nearly full score on ARC-AGI-3 without writing programs.
why_it_matters_hint: Better visual input and memory, not a new model, may explain much of the gap on this benchmark.
notes: Single Chinese outlet with enthusiastic wording; results come from the authors' paper (preprint) on the 25 public games, not independently reviewed. 36Kr says scorecards appear on the ARC Prize platform; not checked.
